name: Historic Centre of Santa Ana de los Ríos de Cuenca
description: Cuenca is a colonial city high in the Andes of southern Ecuador, at about 2,500 metres, where four rivers run through the valley. Founded in 1557 on the ruins of the Inca city of Tomebamba, its historic centre still follows the neat grid laid out then. Mostly 18th-century buildings, updated in the 19th-century boom in quinine and straw hats, line its streets.
